exposure: Mode of delivery in subsequent birth
History of obstetric anal sphincter injury (OASI)
cohort: Women with a history of OASI who had a subsequent birth
finding: The majority of women who sustain OASI will have a subsequent vaginal delivery and remain asymptomatic at long-term follow-up, with no statistically significant difference in incontinence scores regardless of mode of delivery.
mod_finding: There was no statistically significant difference in St Mark's incontinence scores between modes of birth.
